item.description: This month, nine films on love, desire, and human psychology. by Lindsay Costello I’m certain I don’t need to tell you this, but: Shit sucks. item.title: For you know not what to say
item.description: by Anonymous I don’t know who you are, or whether you’re a man or a woman. I may never see you. I may never hug you or cry with you or get drunk with you. But I love you. I hope you escape this place. I hope that the world turns and that things get better, and that one day people have roses again. I wish I could kiss you.
